description.value: Clayton Falls is a waterfall in BC's Cariboo, Chilcotin and Central Interior region, listed as a recreation site managed by BC Hydro. Located in one of BC's more remote and sparsely populated regions, it would serve as a scenic natural waypoint for touring cyclists on longer routes through the interior. The BC Hydro recreation site designation suggests some level of recreational infrastructure may be present, though details could not be confirmed.
